## DESCRIPTION

*t.water.hazard* takes an input watermask STRDS generated by
[t.sentinel_1.watermasks](https://github.com/mundialis/t.sentinel_1.water/tree/main/t.sentinel_1.watermasks)
and calculates flood frequency and flood depth maps from it.
